title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Dissociative adsorption of formic acid on anatase TiO2 nanoparticles
citation: Synthetic fixture for pipeline testing; not a real publication.
materials: anatase TiO2 nanoparticles (~20 nm) with predominantly (101) facets
objective: Identify the adsorption mode of formic acid on anatase TiO2 at room temperature.
key_findings: XRD shows phase-pure anatase; no lattice parameters are reported.
TEM shows truncated bipyramids dominated by (101) facets.
DRIFTS shows asymmetric and symmetric OCO stretches at 1560 and 1360 cm-1 and no C=O band near 1700 cm-1.
O 1s XPS shows a new component at 531.6 eV.
author_interpretations: The OCO splitting of 200 cm-1 indicates bridging bidentate formate over two five-fold coordinated Ti atoms.
The acidic proton transfers to a neighbouring two-fold coordinated bridging oxygen, forming a surface hydroxyl.
